title: Swerve vs. Hangman: obsession and revenge
summary: A challenge to Hangman’s position in AEW spirals into an intensely personal cycle of retaliation.

chapters.title: Swerve beats Hangman
chapters.result: Swerve defeats Page in their first singles meeting.
chapters.context: The result establishes Swerve as a direct threat to Hangman.

chapters.title: Texas Death
chapters.result: Swerve wins the Texas Death match.
chapters.context: The escalating grudge produces another defeat for Page.

chapters.title: Hangman wins the cage fight
chapters.result: Page defeats Swerve in an unsanctioned Lights Out cage match.
chapters.context: The revenge chapter reaches its most destructive confrontation.
